topic_angle: ある朝、急にふらついたAさんの話
topic_angle_en: The story of A-san who suddenly felt dizzy one morning

target_viewer.living_situation: lives independently or with family, still handles daily routines alone
target_viewer.daily_context: occasionally experiences light-headedness when getting up in the morning, getting out of bed, or standing from a seated position; may feel briefly unsteady but has not discussed it with anyone
target_viewer.information_need: wants to understand why this happens in daily life and learn small, reassuring habits that might help — without medical jargon or fear of disease

viewer_problem: 朝、起き上がったときや立ち上がったとき、ふらっとすることが増えたけれど、病院に行くほどでもないと感じている。でも、少し不安。誰かにそっと教えてほしい、こういうとき何を気をつけたらいいのか。
viewer_problem_en: Some mornings, getting out of bed brings a brief wave of unsteadiness. It does not feel serious enough for a hospital visit, but it is quietly worrying. The viewer wants someone to gently explain what might be happening and what small things to look out for.
working_promise: Aさんという方の朝のふらつきのお話を通して、なぜ朝の動き始めにふらっとしやすいのか、日常の中で気をつけられることを一緒に見ていきます。
working_promise_en: Through the story of A-san's morning dizziness, we will gently explore why the body can feel unsteady when first moving in the morning, and walk through small daily habits that may help.

this_video_claims: 朝の起き上がりや立ち上がりで、ふらつきを感じるシニアは少なくない
ふらつきには、血圧の変動や水分不足、内耳の機能低下など日常的な要因が関わっていることがある
起き上がる前の小さな準備動作（ゆっくり体を起こす、足を動かしてから立つなど）が役立つことがある
水分補給のタイミングや睡眠の質を見直すことも、ふらつき軽減につながる場合がある
強いめまいや繰り返すふらつきは、かかりつけ医に相談することが大切
this_video_does_NOT_claim: この方法でめまいが治る
ふらつきを完全に防げる
薬を飲まなくても大丈夫
病院に行く必要はない

forbidden_claims: 「これでめまいが治ります」— dizziness cure promise
「ふらつきを完全に防げます」— absolute fall/dizziness prevention
「薬なしでふらつきが消える」— medication replacement framing
「医者が教えてくれないめまいの原因」— anti-doctor conspiracy
「この体操で平衡感覚が戻る」— guaranteed recovery of balance function
「これだけ気をつければ大丈夫」— sufficiency guarantee

research_questions.question: 高齢者における起立性低血圧・起床時ふらつきの有病率と主な要因（厚生労働省・日本老年医学会等の報告）
research_questions.question_en: Prevalence and primary factors of orthostatic hypotension and morning dizziness in Japanese elderly — MHLW, Japan Geriatrics Society reports

research_questions.question: めまい・ふらつきの日常的な原因分類：血圧変動、脱水、内耳機能低下、薬の副作用など（日本めまい平衡医学会等）
research_questions.question_en: Classification of everyday dizziness causes: blood pressure fluctuation, dehydration, inner ear function decline, medication side effects — Japan Society for Equilibrium Research

research_questions.question: 高齢者の起き上がり動作と転倒予防のための推奨動作手順（厚労省介護予防事業・地域包括支援センター資料）
research_questions.question_en: Recommended getting-up movement sequences for fall prevention in elderly — MHLW care prevention program, community support center materials

research_questions.question: 水分補給と朝のふらつきの関係：高齢者における脱水傾向と夜間・起床時の水分摂取推奨（日本救急医学会等）
research_questions.question_en: Relationship between hydration and morning dizziness: dehydration tendency in elderly and recommended morning/nighttime fluid intake — Japan Association for Acute Medicine

research_questions.question: 高齢者の睡眠の質と朝のふらつき・日中の転倒リスクの関連（国立長寿医療研究センター等の研究）
research_questions.question_en: Association between sleep quality and morning dizziness / daytime fall risk in elderly — National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology studies

research_questions.question: ふらつき・めまいで医療機関を受診すべきタイミングの判断基準（日本耳鼻咽喉科頭頸部外科学会の一般向けガイド）
research_questions.question_en: When to seek medical attention for dizziness — public-facing guide from Japan Society of Otorhinolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery
research_questions.source_type_expected: medical society public guide, patient information leaflet

planned_sections.label: オープニング — ある朝のAさん
planned_sections.purpose: gentle kamishibai story opening: A-san wakes up, sits up in bed, and the room tilts slightly
planned_sections.editorial_note: relatable everyday moment; no alarm, no diagnosis; just a quiet 'oh, that happened again' feeling

planned_sections.label: Aさんのふらつき — どんな感じだったか
planned_sections.label_en: A-san's dizziness — what it felt like
planned_sections.purpose: describe the sensation: brief unsteadiness when first getting up, the world shifting for a moment, then settling
planned_sections.editorial_note: use storytelling to normalize the experience; avoid medical terminology; keep in A-san perspective

planned_sections.label: なぜ朝にふらつきやすいのか — 体にはこんな理由がある
planned_sections.label_en: Why mornings can be unsteady — what happens in the body
planned_sections.purpose: gentle explanation of blood pressure shifts on waking, mild dehydration after sleep, inner ear sensitivity with age
planned_sections.editorial_note: frame as 'your body has been resting all night, so it takes a moment to catch up'; cite RQ1/RQ2; calm tone, no fear

planned_sections.label: Aさんが気づいた小さなこと① — 起き上がり方を変えてみた
planned_sections.label_en: Small thing A-san noticed ① — trying a different way to get up
planned_sections.purpose: first practical reflection: sit on the edge of the bed for a moment, wiggle toes, stand slowly
planned_sections.editorial_note: show the movement sequence as a kamishibai card series; cite RQ3 recommendations; no exercise instruction framing

planned_sections.label: Aさんが気づいた小さなこと② — 朝のお水を一杯
planned_sections.label_en: Small thing A-san noticed ② — one glass of water in the morning
planned_sections.purpose: second practical reflection: bedside water, sipping before standing, hydration awareness
planned_sections.editorial_note: kamishibai card of a glass of water on a bedside table; cite RQ4; frame as habit, not prescription

planned_sections.label: Aさんが気づいた小さなこと③ — 夜の過ごし方を少し見直す
planned_sections.label_en: Small thing A-san noticed ③ — slightly adjusting evening routine
planned_sections.purpose: third practical reflection: sleep quality, evening light, late-night fluid timing
planned_sections.editorial_note: link evening habits to morning steadiness; cite RQ5; keep gentle, not prescriptive

planned_sections.label: Aさんのその後 — 少しずつ朝が楽になった
planned_sections.label_en: After that — A-san's mornings became a little easier
planned_sections.purpose: story resolution: A-san's mornings improved slightly; the dizziness didn't vanish but became less startling
planned_sections.editorial_note: do NOT claim cure; frame as 'the mornings felt a little less uncertain'; story-first closure

planned_sections.label: もしふらつきが続くなら — かかりつけ医に相談を
planned_sections.label_en: If dizziness continues — talk to your doctor
planned_sections.purpose: soft consult-a-clinician framing: when morning dizziness is frequent, strong, or accompanied by other symptoms
planned_sections.editorial_note: cite RQ6 criteria; encourage consultation without inducing worry; mention ear/nose/throat or internal medicine as starting points

planned_sections.label: おわりのことば — 朝の動き始めをそっと大切に
planned_sections.label_en: Closing words — gently honoring the first moments of morning
planned_sections.purpose: warm kamishibai closing; quiet reassurance; no recap checklist, stay in story mood
planned_sections.editorial_note: end with the image of A-san sitting on the bed edge, sunlight through the window, taking a breath before standing

notes_for_research: RQ1 — prioritize MHLW (厚生労働省) elderly health survey data and Japan Geriatrics Society position papers on orthostatic hypotension in elderly
RQ2 — Japan Society for Equilibrium Research (日本めまい平衡医学会) general-audience materials are ideal; avoid overly clinical inner-ear diagnostics
RQ3 — search for municipal care-prevention (介護予防) pamphlets with illustrated getting-up sequences; these exist from Tokyo, Osaka, Yokohama
RQ4 — look for NHK健康チャンネル or 日本救急医学会 general guidance on senior dehydration; connect to morning dizziness specifically
RQ5 — National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology (国立長寿医療研究センター) sleep-and-fall studies; do NOT frame poor sleep as a disease
RQ6 — Japan Society of Otorhinolaryngology public-facing 'when to see a doctor for dizziness' Guide; use as the basis for S08 consult framing
General — all sources should be from the last 5 years when possible; this topic has stable evidence so older major sources are acceptable
Story note — maintain A-san as a composite character throughout; do NOT claim this is a real person's medical history
